summary: This generated API catalog derives operation IDs, names, effects, hosts, budgets, confirmations and host-specific compatibility notes from source-owned descriptors. It is a discovery index; strict input/output contracts and grants remain authoritative. The fixed required-family matrix passes for this snapshot, while descriptor availability is not proof of release certification. Desktop and Terminal create linked scenes through rp-core and run extension prompt and scene-event hooks on Core turns; Browser/Pocket has no rp-core owner and uses its in-memory legacy path. Core delete and take fork, non-connection/backdrop setting selectors, and summary/Compendium follow-on jobs remain unavailable for linked scenes.
